name: ambiguous
description: Ambiguous is a workspace where people and AI teammates work side by side — docs, sheets, slides, wiki, tasks, CRM, calendar, mail, chat and Drive in one place, over one set of records and one permission model. This plugin teaches Claude to work in that workspace the way a colleague would, through the `ambiguous` CLI: resolve a link someone pasted, read the planning doc before changing it, file tasks from a meeting note, update a CRM record after a call. Nothing to install and nothing binds at startup — it runs via npx and works in the session you add it to. Claude acts with exactly the permissions the credential carries.
